coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs m_a in eV; qualitative bound region only
notes: This paper uses black hole superradiance from heavy quasar spins to constrain ultralight bosons (scalar/vector/tensor). The primary results are mass-range exclusions (2.9e-21 - 1.7e-17 eV for scalars) and upper bounds on the axion decay constant f_a in the mu-f_a plane (Figs 6-8). The decay-constant bounds are shown as filled 2D exclusion regions rather than a single limit curve, spanning roughly f_a ~ 1e13-1e18 GeV over mu ~ 1e-21-1e-16 eV. No coupling to photons/electrons/nucleons is constrained; this is a gravitational/self-interaction constraint. Extraction confidence is low because the numerical f_a limit is a 2D shaded region not tabulated, and the main deliverable is a mass-range exclusion rather than a coupling curve.
